semiconductor_relevance: High — Semight Instruments specializes in high-end test and measurement instruments specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: Semight Instruments Co., Ltd. is a global supplier of advanced test and measurement equipment tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include high-speed communication testing tools, optical chip testing devices, and power semiconductor testing solutions, catering to both R&D and high-volume manufacturing needs.

regional_presence.China: Semight Instruments is based in China and serves global customers with its advanced testing solutions.
